prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 2D game directional locomotion sprite sheet.
Input image: reference image ONLY for character identity, proportions, colors, linework; do not copy its backdrop.
Primary request: Create 24 NEW running poses of the exact turquoise Bulbasaur thorn-grove character shown in the reference, arranged in exactly SIX columns and FOUR rows, evenly spaced isolated full-body poses. Preserve turquoise squat quadruped body, dark teal diamond patches, pointed ears, white claws, green eyes, dense leafy shrub on back with two arching leafy vines, crisp dark outline and soft cel shading.
Row 1: NORTH, directly away from viewer, rear view, face hidden behind shrub.
Row 2: NORTHEAST, diagonally away toward upper right, rear three-quarter view, rear and right flank visible.
Row 3: SOUTHEAST, diagonally toward viewer and lower right, front three-quarter view, face and rightward pointing snout visible.
Row 4: SOUTH, straight toward viewer, symmetrical frontal view, both eyes visible.
Each row is a six-frame looping quadruped run cycle: contact, compression, push-off, opposite contact, opposite compression, opposite push-off. Clearly alternating leg motion with gentle leafy vine follow-through, consistent body volume and camera angle in each row. Keep each sprite centered in its own equal grid cell, same scale throughout, generous empty transparent gutters around every silhouette and between all rows and columns. No cropped leaves, no overlap.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no gradient, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Match existing hand-drawn game illustration style; not pixel art. Exactly 6 by 4 grid.
